program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]

    def intervals(size, dividers):
        result, start = [], 0
        for index in dividers:
            if start < index:
                result.append((start, index))
            start = index + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    row_parts = intervals(h, divider_rows)
    col_parts = intervals(w, divider_cols)
    panels = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            score = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            panels.append((score, ri, ci, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    _, _, _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(panels)
    tile = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_parts:
        for c0, c1 in col_parts:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    result[r][c] = tile[(r - r0) % len(tile)][(c - c0) % len(tile[0])]
    return result
'''
